title: Infrastructure Cloud Queue AWS SQS Entity
description: AWS Simple Queue Service (SQS) configuration properties.

fifo_queue.description: Whether the queue is a FIFO queue (guarantees ordering).

content_based_deduplication.description: Whether content-based deduplication is enabled (FIFO queues only).

delay_seconds.description: Default delay in seconds before messages become visible.

receive_wait_time_seconds.description: Long polling wait time in seconds.

dead_letter_target_arn.description: ARN of the dead letter queue.

max_receive_count.description: Number of receive attempts before sending to dead letter queue.

kms_master_key_id.description: KMS key ID for server-side encryption.
